schemes.gives_en: Rs 6,000 a year per farmer family, paid in three instalments of Rs 2,000.
schemes.gives_hi: हर किसान परिवार को साल में 6,000 रुपये, 2,000 रुपये की तीन किस्तों में।
schemes.eligibility_en: Families with cultivable land in their own names (some groups are excluded).
schemes.eligibility_hi: जिन परिवारों के नाम पर खेती की ज़मीन है (कुछ वर्ग शामिल नहीं हैं)।

documents.hi: आपके नाम पर ज़मीन का रिकॉर्ड

schemes.apply_en: PM-KISAN portal or your patwari / agriculture office
schemes.apply_hi: पीएम-किसान पोर्टल या पटवारी / कृषि कार्यालय

gives.title: District Pune (Govt of Maharashtra) scheme page: PM-KISAN
gives.quote: Financial benefit of Rs. 6000 per annum per family payable in three equal installments of Rs 2000 each, every four months.

eligibility.title: District Pune (Govt of Maharashtra) scheme page: PM-KISAN
eligibility.quote: All landholding farmers’ families, which have cultivable land holding in their names are eligible to get benefit under the scheme.

schemes.name_en: Kisan Credit Card with interest support
schemes.gives_en: Crop loans through a Kisan Credit Card at a subsidised interest rate, about 4% if repaid on time.
schemes.gives_hi: किसान क्रेडिट कार्ड से रियायती ब्याज पर फ़सल ऋण; समय पर चुकाने पर लगभग 4% ब्याज।
schemes.eligibility_en: Farmers taking short-term crop loans from a bank through KCC.
schemes.eligibility_hi: बैंक से किसान क्रेडिट कार्ड द्वारा अल्पकालिक फ़सल ऋण लेने वाले किसान।

gives.title: PM India: Cabinet approves continuation of Modified Interest Subvention Scheme
gives.quote: MISS is a Central Sector Scheme aimed at ensuring the availability of short-term credit to farmers at an affordable interest rate through Kisan Credit card (KCC).

gives.title: PM India: Cabinet approves continuation of Modified Interest Subvention Scheme
gives.quote: farmers repaying loans promptly are eligible for an incentive of up to 3% as Prompt Repayment Incentive (PRI) effectively reducing their interest rate on KCC loans to 4%.

schemes.gives_en: Crop insurance where you pay at most 2% of the sum insured for kharif, 1.5% for rabi and 5% for horticultural crops.
schemes.gives_hi: फ़सल बीमा: आप खरीफ़ में अधिकतम 2%, रबी में 1.5% और बागवानी फ़सलों में 5% प्रीमियम देते हैं।
schemes.eligibility_en: Farmers growing notified crops in a notified area for the season.
schemes.eligibility_hi: अधिसूचित क्षेत्र में अधिसूचित फ़सल उगाने वाले किसान।
schemes.apply_en: Bank, common service centre or the PMFBY portal
schemes.apply_hi: बैंक, जन सेवा केंद्र या PMFBY पोर्टल

gives.title: District Hojai (Govt of Assam) scheme page: PMFBY
gives.quote: It envisages a uniform premium of only 2 per cent to be paid by farmers for Kharif crops, and 1.5 per cent for Rabi crops.

gives.title: District Hojai (Govt of Assam) scheme page: PMFBY
gives.quote: The premium for annual commercial and horticultural crops will be 5 per cent.

schemes.name_en: PMKSY Per Drop More Crop (drip and sprinkler)
schemes.name_hi: पीएमकेएसवाई पर ड्रॉप मोर क्रॉप (ड्रिप और स्प्रिंकलर)
schemes.gives_en: Help with the cost of drip or sprinkler irrigation. The share depends on your farm size and the state; check it on the MPFSTS portal.
schemes.gives_hi: ड्रिप या स्प्रिंकलर सिंचाई की लागत में मदद। हिस्सा खेत के आकार और राज्य पर निर्भर है; MPFSTS पोर्टल पर देखें।
schemes.eligibility_en: Farmers installing micro irrigation; in Madhya Pradesh through the horticulture department.
schemes.eligibility_hi: सूक्ष्म सिंचाई लगाने वाले किसान; मध्यप्रदेश में उद्यानिकी विभाग के माध्यम से।

gives.title: Department of Horticulture, Nagaland: Per Drop More Crop
gives.quote: Increase the area under micro irrigation technologies to enhance water use efficiency in the country.

gives.title: PMKSY Micro Irrigation portal, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
gives.quote: Revised Guidelines of PMKSY Per Drop More Crop (Micro Irrigation)

apply.title: Horticulture and Food Processing Department, Madhya Pradesh
apply.note: Listed under central schemes by the MP horticulture department.

schemes.gives_en: A standalone solar pump up to 7.5 HP where there is no grid power; the Centre pays 30% of the cost and the state at least 30%.
schemes.gives_hi: बिना बिजली कनेक्शन वाली जगह 7.5 HP तक का सोलर पंप; केंद्र 30% और राज्य कम से कम 30% लागत देता है।
schemes.eligibility_en: Individual farmers in off-grid areas (no grid supply).
schemes.eligibility_hi: जहाँ बिजली ग्रिड नहीं है, वहाँ के किसान।
schemes.apply_en: State nodal agency for PM-KUSUM (in MP, the renewable energy department)
schemes.apply_hi: राज्य की पीएम-कुसुम नोडल एजेंसी (मध्यप्रदेश में नवीन एवं नवकरणीय ऊर्जा विभाग)

eligibility.title: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy: PM-KUSUM
eligibility.quote: Individual farmers will be supported to install standalone solar Agriculture pumps of capacity up to 7.5 HP in off-grid areas, where grid supply is not available.

gives.title: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy: PM-KUSUM
gives.quote: CFA of 30% of the benchmark cost or the tender cast, whichever is lower, of the stand-alone solar Agriculture pump will be provided.

schemes.gives_en: 40% of the cost of setting up a new fruit garden (planting material, inputs, irrigation), paid over 3 years.
schemes.gives_hi: नया फल बाग लगाने की लागत का 40% (पौधे, सामग्री, सिंचाई), 3 साल में।
schemes.eligibility_en: Farmers establishing new gardens of fruit crops.
schemes.eligibility_hi: नए फल बाग लगाने वाले किसान।
schemes.apply_en: District horticulture office or the MPFSTS portal
schemes.apply_hi: ज़िला उद्यानिकी कार्यालय या MPFSTS पोर्टल

gives.title: State Horticulture Mission, Telangana: MIDH components
gives.quote: Under this programme 40% subsidy is given to the farmers for establishing new gardens.
gives.note: MIDH norms as published by a state horticulture mission (Telangana); MP implements the same mission.

schemes.gives_en: 50% help with the cost of a water harvesting structure such as a farm pond.
schemes.gives_hi: खेत तालाब जैसी जल संग्रहण संरचना की लागत में 50% मदद।
schemes.eligibility_en: Farmers creating a water source for horticulture crops.
schemes.eligibility_hi: बागवानी फ़सलों के लिए पानी का स्रोत बनाने वाले किसान।
schemes.apply_en: District horticulture office or the MPFSTS portal
schemes.apply_hi: ज़िला उद्यानिकी कार्यालय या MPFSTS पोर्टल

gives.title: State Horticulture Mission, Telangana: MIDH components
gives.quote: 50% assistance is provided on prorate basis for Water Harvesting System of various sizes.
gives.note: MIDH norms as published by a state horticulture mission (Telangana).

schemes.gives_en: 50% help with building a naturally ventilated polyhouse or net house, and its planting material.
schemes.gives_hi: प्राकृतिक हवादार पॉलीहाउस या नेट हाउस बनाने और पौध सामग्री में 50% मदद।
schemes.eligibility_en: Farmers growing high-value vegetables or flowers under protection.
schemes.eligibility_hi: संरक्षित खेती में क़ीमती सब्ज़ियाँ या फूल उगाने वाले किसान।
schemes.apply_en: District horticulture office or the MPFSTS portal
schemes.apply_hi: ज़िला उद्यानिकी कार्यालय या MPFSTS पोर्टल

gives.title: State Horticulture Mission, Telangana: MIDH components
gives.quote: 50% assistance is provided towards construction of naturally ventilated poly houses, net houses, and plant material of high value vegetables and flowers.
gives.note: MIDH norms as published by a state horticulture mission (Telangana).

schemes.gives_en: 3% a year interest support on loans up to Rs 2 crore for storage, pack houses and other post-harvest infrastructure.
schemes.gives_hi: भंडारण, पैक हाउस और कटाई के बाद की सुविधाओं के लिए 2 करोड़ रुपये तक के ऋण पर 3% सालाना ब्याज सहायता।
schemes.eligibility_en: Farmers, FPOs, cooperatives, self-help groups and agri-entrepreneurs.
schemes.eligibility_hi: किसान, एफपीओ, सहकारी समितियाँ, स्वयं सहायता समूह और कृषि उद्यमी।
schemes.apply_en: Your nearby agriculture office or bank

gives.title: Agriculture Department Uttarakhand: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund
gives.quote: there is a provision of providing interest subsidy of 3 percent on all types of loans up to a limit of Rs 2 crore.

eligibility.title: PM India: Cabinet approves Agriculture Infrastructure Fund

apply.title: Agriculture Department Uttarakhand: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund
apply.quote: Please visit your nearby Agriculture Office.

schemes.gives_en: Training on natural farming and making inputs like jeevamrit, with local Krishi Sakhis helping farmers in village clusters.
schemes.gives_hi: प्राकृतिक खेती और जीवामृत जैसे आदान बनाने का प्रशिक्षण; गाँव के क्लस्टरों में कृषि सखियों की मदद।
schemes.eligibility_en: Willing farmers in the selected village clusters.
schemes.eligibility_hi: चुने गए गाँव क्लस्टरों के इच्छुक किसान।
schemes.apply_en: Your Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) or block agriculture office
schemes.apply_hi: कृषि विज्ञान केंद्र (KVK) या ब्लॉक कृषि कार्यालय

gives.title: PM India: Launch of National Mission on Natural Farming
gives.quote: willing farmers will be trained in Model Demonstration Farms on the NF package of practices, preparation of NF inputs, etc.

gives.title: PM India: Launch of National Mission on Natural Farming
gives.quote: 30,000 Krishi Sakhis/ CRPs will be deployed for awareness generation, mobilisation and handholding of willing farmers in the clusters.

schemes.gives_en: State support for planting fruit orchards. The amount is not on the department's page; check the MPFSTS portal.
schemes.gives_hi: फल बाग लगाने के लिए राज्य की सहायता। राशि विभाग के पेज पर नहीं है; MPFSTS पोर्टल पर देखें।
schemes.eligibility_en: Farmers in Madhya Pradesh planting fruit trees.
schemes.eligibility_hi: फलदार पेड़ लगाने वाले मध्यप्रदेश के किसान।

gives.title: Horticulture and Food Processing Department, Madhya Pradesh
gives.quote: राज्य योजनाएं फल क्षेत्र विस्तार मसाला क्षेत्र विस्तार संरक्षित खेती
gives.note: State schemes listed by the MP horticulture department.

apply.title: MP Farmers Subsidy Tracking System (MPFSTS)
apply.quote: उद्यानिकी एवं खाद्य प्रसंस्करण विभाग मध्यप्रदेश फार्मर्स सब्सिडी ट्रैकिंग सिस्टम

schemes.gives_en: State support for protected cultivation (polyhouse, shade net). The amount is not on the department's page; check the MPFSTS portal.
schemes.gives_hi: संरक्षित खेती (पॉलीहाउस, शेड नेट) के लिए राज्य की सहायता। राशि विभाग के पेज पर नहीं है; MPFSTS पोर्टल पर देखें।
schemes.eligibility_en: Farmers in Madhya Pradesh setting up protected cultivation.
schemes.eligibility_hi: संरक्षित खेती लगाने वाले मध्यप्रदेश के किसान।

gives.title: Horticulture and Food Processing Department, Madhya Pradesh
gives.quote: राज्य योजनाएं फल क्षेत्र विस्तार मसाला क्षेत्र विस्तार संरक्षित खेती
gives.note: State schemes listed by the MP horticulture department.

apply.title: MP Farmers Subsidy Tracking System (MPFSTS)
apply.quote: उद्यानिकी एवं खाद्य प्रसंस्करण विभाग मध्यप्रदेश फार्मर्स सब्सिडी ट्रैकिंग सिस्टम
